budget_items.quote: the first one (concept a) by pilla designs was in the $400,000 range ($200,000 in-kind and $200,000 in cash).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total budgeted revenues for FY2018 came in 1.9% above estimates, about $746,058, and expenditures came in 1.7% below original estimates.
budget_items.quote: reported total budgeted revenues for fiscal year 2018 were 1.9% higher than our estimates, which translates into $746,058

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Appropriation and assessment closeouts totalled $689,738, including assessments under the cherry sheet estimates.
budget_items.quote: we had appropriation and assessment closeouts of $689,738.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Local receipts came in $527,353 above estimate; motor vehicle excise collected $207,186 more and penalties and interest $135,040 more than estimated.
budget_items.quote: we collected $207,186 more than estimated in motor vehicle excise taxes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Aggressive tax lien collection produced $511,238 in tax lien revenue.
budget_items.quote: we received $511,238 in tax lien revenue.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State aid came in 98.4% or $137,375 less than estimate, mostly the unpaid 40S (Smart Growth) reimbursement.
budget_items.quote: as far as state aid, we received 98.4% or $137,375 less than the state aid estimate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Assessments were $290,875 less than the cherry sheet estimates.
budget_items.quote: we actually had $290,875 less in assessments less than the cherry sheet estimates.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: General Government closeouts $22,698, Public Safety $86, 977, Education $50,302, and Health, Council on Aging and Veterans $37,638.
budget_items.quote: on the general government side there were appropriation closeouts of $22,698
